title: Scholarly genre profile (Layer 2 — functional roles)
description: Functional-role vocabulary for SCHOLARLY documents (arXiv preprints, PMC open-access articles). A role is an OPTIONAL second label on a layer-1 block; each role declares the layer-1 kind(s) it may attach to. This profile also aligns with the SemantiK `scholarly` lexicon overlay (schemas/taxonomies/semantik_lexicon.json) which coagulates theorem/proof/lemma composite units.
$comment: Grounds the align_gold arxiv LaTeXML (ltx_*) map + the PMC generic-tag fallback into named functional roles. ltx_theorem/ltx_theorem_definition -> theorem; ltx_proof -> proof. Consistency: every role.attaches_to is non-empty.

x-roles.label: Theorem / proposition / corollary
x-roles.description: A formal theorem-family statement (theorem, proposition, corollary, definition-as-theorem).
profile_edges: references (to a lemma / prior theorem it invokes)

x-roles.label: Proof
x-roles.description: A proof body attached to a theorem/lemma.
